MODEL: oak-tree (stabilized). GRID 10x10x10, one block = 100 mm. A cell is (i,j,k).
AXES (as seen in the app's Front view): i = left->right (i=0 is the LEFT side, i=9 the RIGHT). j = depth (j=0 is the FRONT, nearest the viewer; j=9 is the BACK). k = height (k=0 rests on the ground, k=9 is the top).
CURRENT STATE: blocks 91, separate structures 1, floating blocks 0, longest cantilever 3 blocks (limit 4), over the limit 0; centre of gravity inside the base, margin 124 mm; peak joint stress 45% of allowable (0 blocks over 100%).
ISSUES: none.
ROOM (empty blocks the model can still grow into): left(-i) 0, right(+i) 0, front(-j) 2, back(+j) 2, up(+k) 3.
PARTS (names come from the model; letter = region id; trust the cell ranges, not the words left/right in a name):
A "Trunk": 2 blocks, i3 j5 k0-1
B "Roots": 1 blocks, i3 j6 k0
C "Branches": 3 blocks, i3-5 j5 k2
D "Foliage": 63 blocks, i0-6 j2-7 k3-6
E "Tip foliage": 19 blocks, i7-9 j4-6 k2-4
PIECES (region ids for blocks that are not in a named part):
c1 column box: i8 j5 k0-1 (2)
f1 footing box: i3 j4 k0 (1)
TOP HEIGHT of each (i,j) column = highest occupied k ('.' = empty column). Rows: back (high j) at the top, front (low j) at the bottom; columns i=0..9 left to right.
